name: @w6w-apps/livestorm
description: Create and manage Livestorm events, sessions, registrants and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Livestorm runs the webinar or virtual event itself — scheduling it, accepting registrations, running the live session, and recording who actually showed up — and this app brings that lifecycle into a workflow.

Create and manage events (the reusable webinar/meeting definition) and the sessions (individual live occurrences) under them, register or remove participants directly rather than routing them through a separate signup form, bulk-register a whole list at once via an async job, and read chat messages, Q&A questions and recordings back after a session runs. Webhooks let a workflow react to registration, attendance and session-lifecycle events instead of polling for them.

A common pattern is triggering a workflow off an external event — a course enrollment, a CRM stage change, a landing-page form — and registering the person for the right session directly with People Attributes carried over from that source, or reading attendance back afterward to decide who gets which follow-up.

This app covers the everyday event/session/people/job/webhook lifecycle over Livestorm's private API token; it does not cover the OAuth2 app-install flow (a browser-based third-party-integration flow, not a headless server-to-server credential).
